# Figure 2 — Coverage against accuracy: A0 against A0'

## Caption (this is what the paper prints)

**Figure 2. Coverage against accuracy: A0 against A0'.** Evidence coverage on x, accuracy on y, with replay (K1, on-trace) and held-out (K2, off-trace) accuracy plotted as a drop line per run. The drop line is the finding. A0' saw 46.9% of the state-action pairs A0 saw and was more accurate -- re-witnessability beating coverage.
